questions.expl: ：他很成功，并且他的成功有一个秘密。 succeed 成功，动词；successful 成功的，形容词；success 成功，名词；successfully 成功地，副词。 此处需用形容词作表语，故选B。
：他很成功，并且他的成功有一个秘密。 a 不定冠词，一个，用于辅音音素前；an 不定冠词，一个，用于元音音素前；the 定冠词，表示特 指；/零冠词。此处泛指“一个秘密”，secret 以辅音音素开头，应使用a 修饰，故选A。
：他擅长充分利用时间。 make 制作，原形；makes 制作，动词单三；making 制作，动名词/现在分词；made 制作，过去式。 介词at 后需要加动名词形式，故选C。
：他是他父母的第一个孩子。 one 一；first 第一；two 二；the second 第二。根据“looked after his two little brothers”可知他是他父 母的第一个孩子。序数词first 表顺序，故选B。
：所以他照顾爸爸，照顾两个弟弟，帮妈妈做一些家务。 took 带走，过去式；takes 带走，动词单三；take 带走，原形；to take 带走，动词不定式。根据“...looked after his two little brothers and...”可知，本句一般过去时，动词用过去式。故选A。
：所以他照顾爸爸，照顾两个弟弟，帮妈妈做一些家务。 little 少到几乎没有；any 任何，常用于否定句和疑问句；some 一些；few 少到几乎没有。此处是指 帮妈妈做一些家务。故选C。
：他不想在学习上比其他的学生差，所以他每天都努力争取足够的时间学习。 worst 最坏的，最高级；bad 糟糕的；badly 糟糕地，副词；worse 更糟糕，比较级。句中“than”表示 本句应使用比较级，故选D。
：他有很多的兴趣。 much 许多，修饰不可数名词；many 许多，修饰可数名词；more 更多，比较级；most 最多，最高 级。结合后文“For example, he was interested in reading, writing and drawing”可知他有很多兴趣，兴 趣为可数名词，用many 修饰。故选B。
：例如，他对阅读、写作和绘画感兴趣，并且在这些方面都表现出色。 them 它们，宾格；they 它们，主格；themselves 它们自己；their 它们的，形容词性物主代词。空格 处指代的是上文的“reading, writing and drawing”可知是复数，介词of 后需要用宾格them。故选A。
：因为每天没有好好休息他生病很严重。 but 但是；because 因为；however 然而；or 或者，否则。前后为因果关系，属于“前果后因”，所以 用because 引导原因状语从句。故选B。
：他每天晚上都熬夜学习和工作。 late 晚；latest 最新的；later 稍后；lately 最近。固定搭配stay up late 意为“熬夜很晚”，故选A。
：鲁迅认为时间与生命同等重要，任何人都不应该浪费时间。 too 也；so 如此；as 像；very 非常。as…as“和……一样”，故选C。
：鲁迅认为时间与生命同等重要，任何人都不应该浪费时间。 no one 没有人；everyone 每个人；someone 某人；anyone 任何人。此处表示没有人能浪费时间，故 选A。 14．句意：时间就像海绵里的水，你挤一挤，总会有的。 are 是；will 将；were 是；must 必须。if 引导的条件状语从句，满足“主将从现”，因此此空需用一 般将来时，故选B。
：鲁迅的故事鼓励我更加勤奋。 hard-working 勤奋的；less hard-working 不勤奋的；most hard-working 最勤奋的；more hard-working 更勤奋的。much 修饰比较级，表示鼓励我更加勤奋。故选D。
：作为神舟十九号的一员，她在太空方面表现出色。 nature自然；earth地球；ocean海洋；space太空。根据“She is the first astronaut who was born after 1990s.” 可知，她是一名宇航员，故应在太空方面很出色。故选D。
：她也是一名优秀的跑步者，经常在长跑比赛中表现出色。 excellent 优秀的；terrible 糟糕的；common 共同的；careful 小心的。根据“often did well in long-distance races”可知，她跑步能力强。故选A。
：作为尖子生，王能够探索新的研究领域。 prevent 预防；cover 克服；explore 探索；hide 隐藏。根据“new research fields.”可知，这里表示探索 新的领域。故选C。
：这些项目令人兴奋但有困难。 difficult 困难的；simple 简单的；interesting 有趣的；famous 著名的。根据“Wang once complained about the challenges”可知，项目有挑战，即困难的。故选A。
：她的一位老师给了她一些有用的建议。 danger 危险；advice 建议；wealth 财富；beauty 美貌。根据“One of her teachers gave her some useful” 及前文可知，遇到困难时，她的老师会给出有用的建议。故选B。
：老师告诉她，当她遇到困难，要尽最大努力实现梦想。 and 并且；so 所以；when 当……时候；unless 除非。根据“The teacher told her to do her best to achieve her dream”和“she was in trouble.”可知，这里表示当遇到困难的时候。需用when 引导时间状语从句。 故选C。
：毕业后，她发现了对太空科学的热爱。 used 使用；discovered 发现；ended 结束；helped 帮助。根据“her love for space science.”可知，表示 她发现了自己对太空科学的热爱。故选B。
：王学到了很多，并且喜欢解决问题。 problems 问题；license 执照；chances 机会；tricks 诡计。根据“and learned a lot and enjoyed solving” 可知，solve problems“解决问题”，是常见搭配，符合语境。故选A。
：多亏了她强大的身心，她被录用了。 normal 正常的；strong 强壮的；weak 虚弱的；usual 通常的。根据“body and mind, she was accepted.” 可知，航天员训练要求高，需要强大的身心。故选B。
：在训练期间，她面对一个又一个挑战，但她从未想过放弃。 putting out 扑灭；keeping on 继续；lying down 躺下；giving up 放弃。根据“During her training, she faced one challenge after another, but she never thought of”可知，这里表示她从未想过放弃。故选D。

questions.stem: How does Zhang Mingxiang create his pictures?
opts: He shows his opinions on social problems in his pictures.
He takes ideas from his followers on Bilibili.
He expresses his wish for others to get rich in his paintings.
He makes use of homophony with Chinese characters.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“The painter mixes traditional Chinese painting with homophonic elements”可知， 文中明确提到画家将中国传统绘画与谐音元素相结合。故选D。

questions.stem: What made Zhang focus on cute animals?
opts: Cute animals were very popular among people online in 2018.
He read many black-and-white cartoon books in his childhood.
Calligraphy led him to the lively world of cute animals.
His calligraphy didn’t sell well on Douyin.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据文中“The inspiration to focus on cute animals came along in 2018 after he saw people selling Chinese calligraphy (书法) on Douyin. ‘The black and white seemed a bit boring to me,’ Zhang said. ‘I remembered the cartoon books I read as a child. Suddenly, pictures of cute animals came into my mind.’” 可知，看到抖音上的书法作品后，他回忆起童年的卡通书，进而想到可爱动物，是 书法引导他进入可爱动物的生动世界。故选C。

questions.stem: What did Zhang use five squirrels to show?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Once, he was trying to draw a Chinese story about Wu Song fighting a tiger. Then an idea hit him: Why not draw five squirrels (松鼠), which could then be called ‘wu song (五松)’?”可知， 他是想用五只松鼠来谐音武松打虎中的“武松”，也就是表现打虎者。故选D。

questions.stem: What is Zhang trying to do according to the last paragraph?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Now, Zhang also creates all kinds of cultural products with his artwork, including T-shirts and pillows (枕头). He hopes that his style and intellectual property (知识产权) will go abroad one day.”可知，他创作各类文化产品，希望自己的风格和知识产权能走向国外，这是在拓展业务。 故选C。

opts: the earth was warm and wet
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第二段“In the days of dinosaurs, the whole earth was warm and wet.”可知，在 恐龙时代，整个地球温暖潮湿。故选D。

questions.stem: What does the underlined word “freezing” in Paragraph 2 mean?
questions.expl: 猜测题。根据第二段“In the days of dinosaurs, the whole earth was warm and wet. There were many green forests. But the earth changed slowly all the time. When parts of the earth became freezing and dry, the forests there died.”可知，过去整个地球都是温暖潮湿的，有许多绿色的森林，但是现在 森林死亡了，地球的气候与之前的“温暖潮湿”相反，所以是变得寒冷干燥；据此可以推断，划线单 词“freezing”意为“寒冷的”，与“cold”同义。故选B。

questions.stem: How many reasons why dinosaurs died out are talked about in the passage?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第二段“Then dinosaurs could not find enough food to eat. This must be one reason why dinosaurs died out.”、第三段“There were also terrible fights between dinosaurs.”以及第四段“New kinds of animals might come to the earth.”可知，文章主要提到了恐龙灭绝的三个原因。故选C。

questions.stem: According to the passage, we are sure that ________.
opts: not all dinosaurs had very small brains
different kinds of dinosaurs were on the earth
new kinds of animals came to the earth and killed dinosaurs
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第一段“Millions of years ago, dinosaurs controlled the earth. And there were different kinds of dinosaurs on the earth.”可知，数百万年前，地球上确实存在不同种类的恐龙。故选 C。 35．最佳标题题。综合全文，尤其是根据第一段“Later on, there weren’t any dinosaurs. What happened to them?”可知，本文主要介绍了恐龙灭绝的原因；选项A“恐龙为什么灭绝”适合作为文章的标题。 故选A。

questions.stem: Which can be the best title for the passage?

opts: A website where people can find information of 30,000 fish.
A meeting where people discuss the research of the living things.
A large, heavy book which is a record of living things.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“On a new website (www.eol.org), called the Encyclopaedia of Life (EOL), you will find basic facts on about 30,000 species-or kinds-of fish.”可知，它是一个人们可以找到约3 万种鱼 类的基本情况的网站。故选B。

questions.stem: What is “a baby step” in paragraph 2?
questions.expl: 猜测题。根据“Its designers dream of making it the largest biological (生物学的) encyclopaedia ever, with a web page for every living species.”可知，它的设计者梦想使它成为有史以来最大的生物 学的百科全书，因此记录3 万种鱼类的基本情况只是该网站一个小小的成功。划线单词表示“小小 的成功”。故选D。

questions.stem: What can be inferred (推测) from today’s websites and encyclopacdias about living things?
opts: They are not the best tools for scientists.
They are easy to search for information.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“Scientists need websites with information that has been double-checked by other scientists. A dream site would include links to all the basic research and also automatically (自动的) update itself as new research is published”可知，今天关于生物的网站和百科全书很少更新信息。故选 C。 39．细节理解题。根据“Its designers dream of making it the largest biological (生物学的) encyclopaedia ever, with a web page for every living specie.”可知，设计者的目标是提供每个物种的描述。故选B。

questions.stem: What’s the aim (目标) of the EOL designers?
opts: To provide description of every species.
To give correct information to the scientists.
To challenge the other websites and encyclopaedias.

questions.stem: Which one is the best title of this passage?
questions.expl: 标题题。本文主要介绍了一个关于提供每个生物的基本情况的网站，因此最佳标题为“一 本关于生命的‘书’”。故选A。
